versions.changelog:
Initial release of e2e-verify — a skill to verify web app changes by driving a real browser, with careful routing and strong safety rules.

- Supports both ephemeral and durable end-to-end checks via Expect, browser-use, or Claude-driven Playwright, depending on user intent and context.
- Enforces strict safeguards: only non-production targets, no real user cookies or accounts, and explicit reporting of what was tested.
- Produces structured, observation-based evidence for every flow walked; never falsely reports "e2e passes" based on indirect evidence.
- Guides users through test engine setup if none is available, never fails silently.
- Durable Playwright test authoring follows best practices: risk-based test selection, robust selectors, no arbitrary waits, independent test isolation, and red-proof discipline.
- Not for mobile apps, unit/integration test authoring, or e2e debugging; always routes requests by intended use, not just tooling.
